install:
set -eux
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y maven docker.io docker-compose-v2
if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo dockerd >/tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 &
  for _ in $(seq 1 60); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done
  docker info
fi
cd /workspace/server
make setup INPUT_DIR=tests/fixtures/proves
make prepare INPUT_DIR=tests/fixtures/proves
cd /workspace/client
make setup
start:
set -eux
if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo dockerd >/tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 &
  for _ in $(seq 1 60); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done
fi
cd /workspace/server
docker compose up -d yamcs
.venv/bin/python -c "from proves_yamcs.supervisor import wait_until_ready; wait_until_ready('http://127.0.0.1:8090', 'fprime-project', 180)"
